policy: Source-index catalogue; original statements, recorded objections, access limitations and role provenance. No claim percentages, rating people or equating belief with scientific proof.

records.name: AARO
records.description: The U.S. All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office is the Department of Defense's UAP investigation and reporting organisation. Its director, releases, case reports and data-access limits should be distinguished from a former director's subsequent personal commentary.

sources.title: AARO official mission and vision
sources.scope: The official office page documents its stated mission, not proof that all cases have been explained.

sources.title: AARO official congressional and press products
sources.scope: Dated AARO releases can be checked against an individual's exact public statement and agency tenure.

records.name: AATIP
records.description: The Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program label appears in public reporting and former officials' accounts. Its precise scope, funding, and organisational relationship to DIA's AAWSAP have been described differently; present both original government records and attributed participant accounts.

sources.title: DIA original AAWSAP procurement/contract talking points
sources.role: official AAWSAP baseline used for comparison
sources.scope: The DIA's original public procurement record supports an AAWSAP contract, not an automatic conclusion that every account using the AATIP label refers to the same activity.

sources.title: AARO historical report index and press resources
sources.scope: AARO's retrospective interpretation should be labelled as its published position and contrasted with first-person accounts.

records.name: AAWSAP
records.description: The Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program is documented in Defense Intelligence Agency contracting materials. The September 2008 contract went to Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies for unconventional aerospace research; the award alone does not validate extraordinary claims.

sources.title: DIA AAWSAP contract talking points
sources.scope: DIA records the contract and research areas, but does not independently establish recovered spacecraft or a specific person's unpublished role.

sources.title: AARO official historical report index
sources.scope: Keep the distinction between contracted studies, participant testimony and AARO's retrospective assessment.

records.name: Project Blue Book
records.description: The U.S. Air Force's historical UFO investigation. Original case files are preserved at the U.S. National Archives, with indexes, case summaries and the Air Force's published conclusions. These are valuable primary records, not automatically proof of extraterrestrial origin.

sources.title: U.S. National Archives Blue Book research guide
sources.scope: Search original case files and distinguish unexplained case status from extraterrestrial identification.

sources.title: NARA Blue Book archival record and historical overview
sources.scope: Provides contemporary archival interpretation and dates for the project; check actual case source before asserting outcomes.

records.name: National Institute for Discovery Science (NIDS)
records.description: Privately funded investigation associated with Robert Bigelow and the Utah property later widely called Skinwalker Ranch. Published retrospective descriptions refer to investigators and instruments, but complete original study logs, chain of custody and raw sensor datasets require verification.

sources.title: History: Skinwalker Ranch original-owner research chronology
sources.scope: Reporting identifies Bigelow and historical NIDS investigation activity but does not independently verify paranormal causes.

sources.title: Skinwalker Ranch independent community-archived files
sources.scope: Reproduced or archived NIDS material must be traced back to primary creators, dates and custody before claimed as independent original measurements.

records.name: Skinwalker Ranch
records.description: A Utah property associated with reported unusual observations, NIDS/Bigelow investigations and later private media research. Ownership and published witness accounts can be documented, but alleged extraordinary causes and raw sensor interpretations are unresolved.

sources.title: History: Brandon Fugal owner profile
sources.scope: History reports that Fugal purchased the ranch from Bigelow in 2016, not that the paranormal claims were independently verified.

sources.title: History: Skinwalker Ranch historical background
sources.scope: Publisher report aggregates historical claims; original audio, telemetry, physical exhibits and custody need independent inspection.

records.name: Vatican, Vatican Observatory & Apostolic Archive
records.kind: Religious institution, scientific observatory and archive
records.period: Historical records through 1958; continuing scientific and theological work
records.description: An evidence-first directory of what the Church's scientists and archives have actually published about astronomy and possible extraterrestrial life, the historically alleged 1933 Italian UFO claim, and the Vatican archive's on-record response. A religious or spiritual phenomenon is not itself evidence of an alien craft.

sources.title: Vatican Observatory — original discussion of extraterrestrial life
sources.role: astronomers' public discussion and scientific evidential caution
sources.scope: Astronomers explore the possibility of extraterrestrial life but report no substantiated discovery; this does not prove secret Vatican documents.

sources.title: Vatican Observatory — official astronomy education resources
sources.scope: The observatory provides research/theology discussions; hypothesis and Christian theology do not replace original UFO sensor data.

sources.title: Vatican Apostolic Archive — official access and consultation rules
sources.scope: Qualified researchers can request records currently open through October 1958; access rules do not establish that any 1933 UFO record exists.

sources.title: Catholic News Service — archival official comments, June 2024
sources.scope: Archive representative Marco Grilli said the institution held no documents concerning extraterrestrial life; the denial is a documented response, not a complete independent catalogue audit.

sources.title: Dicastery for Doctrine of Faith — May 2024 supernatural phenomena norms
sources.scope: Rules concern alleged supernatural/religious phenomena and pastoral discernment, not government or scientific UFO classification.

sources.title: Catholic News Service — 1933 Italy / Vatican claim and archival denial
sources.scope: Grusch's public allegation involving Mussolini-era Italy and Pope Pius XII is not independently proven by an original Vatican record here; the same article includes the archives' denial.

comparisons.topic: Alleged 1933 craft / Vatican relay to the United States
comparisons.sideA: David Grusch's public allegation that Vatican channels relayed knowledge relating to an alleged craft recovered in Mussolini-era Italy.
comparisons.sideB: In a June 2024 interview, Vatican archive official Marco Grilli said the archive held no documents relating to extraterrestrial life.
comparisons.caution: An archival official's reported denial and an attributed allegation can be compared; this is not a finding that either person deliberately lied or that a complete Vatican archive search was conducted.
